subject: Welcome to the University Alumni Network!
body:
Dear $full_name,

Welcome to the University Alumni Network! We're delighted that you've joined our community of graduates.

As a member of our alumni network, you'll receive:
- Invitations to exclusive alumni events and networking opportunities
- Regular updates on university news and achievements
- Access to career resources and continuous learning opportunities
- Chances to connect with fellow alumni across the globe

You can update your profile information and preferences at any time through the Alumni Portal.

We look forward to staying connected!

Best regards,
The Alumni Relations Team
